scope: Diagnostic full-worker CPU sampling at 1ms, one run per variant in core/layer order. Includes imports, fixture parsing, constructor warm-up, same-width catalog copy/freeze, refresh, asserted translations, retained snapshots, explicit GC and idle. Samples are not limited to refresh; async ancestry and inlined/native frames can be absent. Self percentages use all samples; inclusive rows overlap. Counts and timeDeltas are not exact function CPU time or allocations. Profiled worker timings are deliberately omitted and are not an unprofiled performance or end-to-end latency comparison. Prepared two-locale/one-namespace/10k fixture only.
